grades.reason: Describes the LoongArch IDLE instruction (waiting for an interrupt). It says nothing about clearing a pending timer interrupt.
Covers RISC-V supervisor sip/sie timer interrupt bits. The query requires LoongArch, so this is the wrong ISA.

grades.quote: The interrupt status bit. 1 indicates that the corresponding interrupt is set up.
grades.reason: This is the LoongArch ESTAT register. Its IS[12:2] field holds the timer interrupt (TI) status and is read-only, so writing ESTAT cannot clear a pending timer interrupt. That is limited auxiliary information. The passage never names the actual clearing mechanism, the TICLR register.
